name: Sajópálfala (Hungary)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sajópálfala (a blue shield with a yellow ploughshare, a patriarchal cross and a wavy stripe) below the name SAJÓPÁLFALA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
